row: 淡江大橋跨越淡水河口，連接淡水與八里，2026 年 5 月通車；主橋 920 公尺，單一橋塔高 211 公尺，是全球最長的單塔不對稱斜張橋。

airspace.zh: 淡水河口一帶空域請以民航局「遙控無人機管理資訊系統」查詢；本片為電腦擬真畫面，非實地空拍。
airspace.en: Check the airspace around the Tamsui river mouth with the CAA drone system before flying. This film is simulated, not real drone footage.

pylon.note: single pylon, 211 m (point between the two bus lanes that part round it)

bali.note: south end of the main bridge

tamsui.note: north end of the main bridge

wharf.note: north bank of the river mouth

youche.note: riverside boardwalk, the weather agency's first pick for sunsets

title.zh-Hant: 淡江大橋：穿過塔心的光
title.en: Danjiang Bridge: light through the tower

tagline.zh-Hant: 8 月的夕陽與 10 月的晨光，各自穿過橋塔中心
tagline.en: An August sunset and an October sunrise, each through the heart of the pylon

zh: 淡水河口，淡江大橋橫跨淡水與八里之間。
2026 年 5 月通車，主橋長 920 公尺。
en: At the mouth of the Tamsui River, the Danjiang Bridge links Tamsui and Bali.
It opened in May 2026; the main bridge is 920 m long.

zh: 單一橋塔高 211 公尺，是全球最長的單塔不對稱斜張橋。
設計採用札哈·哈蒂團隊與中興工程的方案。
en: With one 211 m pylon, it is the longest single-pylon asymmetric cable-stayed bridge in the world.
The design comes from the Zaha Hadid team with Sinotech Engineering.

zh: 橋面寬 44 到 71 公尺，汽機車、自行車與行人都能通行。
中央預留輕軌路廊，目前先作為公車專用道。
en: The deck is 44 to 71 m wide, for cars, motorcycles, bicycles and people on foot.
A corridor in the middle is kept for light rail; for now buses use it.

zh: 為了不擋住淡水夕照，橋塔刻意移向淡水一側。
設計團隊走訪 12 處觀景點，模擬四季的日落位置。
en: To keep the famous Tamsui sunset, the pylon was moved toward the Tamsui side.
The design team visited 12 viewpoints and simulated where the sun sets in every season.

zh: 北岸的漁人碼頭與情人橋，是看夕陽的老地方。
氣象署推薦全年觀賞首選：淡水油車口木棧道。
en: Fisherman's Wharf and Lover's Bridge on the north bank are old sunset spots.
The weather agency's first pick for any season is the Youchekou boardwalk in Tamsui.

zh: 8 月下旬，太陽沉到兩支塔腳之間。
依當天的日照計算，太陽正好穿過塔心。
en: In late August the sun sinks between the two legs of the pylon.
By the sun position of that day, it passes right through the heart of the tower.

zh: 太陽沒入台灣海峽，河面留下一道金色的光。
對岸觀音山的稜線，慢慢暗成剪影。
en: The sun drops into the Taiwan Strait, leaving a path of gold on the river.
Across the water, the ridge of Guanyin Mountain fades to a silhouette.

zh: 日落後二十分鐘，天空轉成深藍。
淡水河在這裡注入台灣海峽。
en: Twenty minutes after sunset the sky turns deep blue.
Here the Tamsui River flows into the Taiwan Strait.

zh: 兩個月後，十月下旬的清晨。
這個季節，太陽從橋塔的另一側升起。
en: Two months later: a morning in late October.
At this time of year the sun rises on the other side of the pylon.

zh: 晨光穿過塔心，照向淡水的街屋與山。
同一道縫隙，日落與日出各有屬於它的日子。
en: Morning light shines through the heart of the tower toward Tamsui and its hills.
The same gap has its own days for sunset and for sunrise.

zh: 逆光裡，一根根斜張鋼索像豎琴的琴弦。
主跨 450 公尺，伸向八里。
en: Against the morning light the stay cables look like the strings of a harp.
The main span, 450 m long, reaches toward Bali.

zh: 晨光照上觀音山，八里的河岸一點一點亮起來。
觀音山海拔 616 公尺，是淡水河口的地標。
en: Morning sun reaches Guanyin Mountain and the Bali riverbank slowly brightens.
At 616 m, Guanyin Mountain is the landmark of the river mouth.

zh: 從 1980 年代末提出計畫，
到通車那天，走了三十多年。
en: From the first plans in the late 1980s
to opening day took more than thirty years.

zh: 本片為擬真畫面：橋梁以簡化造型重建，
日照依當天的太陽位置計算。
en: Simulated: the bridge is a simplified model,
and the light follows the sun position of each day.
